versions.changelog:
notebooklm-video-research v1.0.0

- Initial release: automate NotebookLM notebook creation from YouTube videos.
- Extracts people from a YouTube video, researches them online, and generates a research document.
- Adds both the video and research as sources in a new NotebookLM notebook.
- Generates an Audio Overview of the notebook automatically.
- Uses screenshot-first automation to verify and reliably interact with UI elements.
- Includes detailed code snippets and selector guidance to avoid common automation pitfalls in NotebookLM.
